description: Evaluate a maths expression safely with the website's own parser (never eval): + − × ÷ ^ (right-associative), implicit multiplication (2(3+4), 2x), postfix ! and %, √, brackets; functions sin cos tan sec csc cot (+ asin acos atan atan2) in degrees (default), radians or grads, sinh cosh tanh and inverses, sqrt cbrt root(x,n) abs exp ln log(x[,base]) log10 log2 floor ceil round sign min max mod nCr nPr fact gamma; constants pi π e tau phi; "ans" and your own variables. Results to 12 significant digits, plain or scientific notation. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/sci-calc/

format.description: Display: normal, or always scientific notation.
